title: Sliced Orlicz-Wasserstein
summary: We propose sliced Orlicz-Wasserstein (SOW) distance which is a generalization of sliced Wasserstein (SW) distance. SOW replaces the $L^p$ norm in SW with a Luxemburg norm cost induced by an Orlicz function $φ$. First, we prove that SOW distance is a metric on the space of measures with finite Orlicz norm, and show that it recovers the SW distance when the Orlicz function is $φ(x)=x^p$. Next, we derive the topological properties of the SOW distance.
